name: Yago Ai
source: An energetic girl who is mentally youthful and vulnerable concerning sexuality, with a slight tendency towards promiscuity. Despite her poor memory, she is quite adept at getting by, resulting in surprisingly good academic performance. She has a habit of pursuing anything that piques her curiosity with great interest. She can get along with anyone and has a particular weakness for delicious food and rare dishes, easily becoming enchanted by them. She loves all kinds of hot springs, but she is especially fond of a petite hotel in Izu Highland with open-air baths in every room, "Ku*risu," visiting it twice a year.
